name: Winson
preview: Sarah: Good night, Winson. Sleep well.

messages.text:
Sorry, one more question. Will the BS-4 come fully assembled and ready to use? (The mean well)

I only need to connect the power cord and network cable, without doing any internal wiring correct
I'll check the product page and the BS-4 notes before I answer.
Searched the web · Bitfortun BS-4 miner Mean Well power supply assembly
Handed to the team · The listing gives the PSU (Mean Well LRS-350, 12V, XT60, 115/230V selector) but

Hi Winson, I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed your question to me.

Here is what the BS-4 listing confirms:

1. The miner itself arrives built. The board, the water cooling and the fans are assembled at the factory, nothing to put together inside the unit.
2. Power is a Mean Well LRS-350, 350W, 12V DC, 100 to 240V input, and it feeds the miner through an XT60 connector.
3. Network is WiFi or ethernet, and setup is done in the web UI, no wiring.

Two things I will not guess at, so I have asked JD (our hardware lead) to confirm them before I give you an answer:

1. The L.350 is an open frame supply with screw terminals, so I want JD to confirm whether yours ships with the AC cord and the DC lead already landed on the terminals or whether a screwdriver is involved.
2. That supply has a 115/230V selector switch. For Malaysia's 240V it must be on 230 before the first plug-in, and I want JD to confirm how it leaves the factory.

Please do not power it on until that second point is checked when the box arrives. I will come back here with JD's answer, and if you step away it reaches your email.

You can also ask him directly on our Discord, he is in there daily: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate.

Oh yes, sorry! I should have asked more simply. I just want to know if the AC power cable and DC cable are already connected, so I don’t need to do any wiring myself.

Okay, no problem. I’ll wait for your confirmation. Thank you

That is exactly the question I put to JD, so you have asked it right. The team has it and will confirm here, and by email if you step away.

While you wait, the one thing to do when the box arrives: before plugging anything in, look at the small switch on the Mean Well supply and make sure it reads 230, not 115. Malaysia is 240V, so a supply left on 115 can be damaged on the first power on. Snap a photo of that switch and the cables as they come out of the box and send it here, and I will tell you straight away if anything still needs connecting.

Thanks for your patience, Winson.
OK, understood. I’ll make sure it’s set to 230V. Thank you for the reminder

Perfect, that is the main one to get right.

When it arrives and you are ready to set it up, I am here. First boot is power on, connect WiFi or ethernet, find the miner in your browser, then set your pool. Easy enough for a first machine.

Enjoy the wait, Winson.
Okay, no problem. Thank you! Please let me know once you receive confirmation about the wiring. If I’m not online, please send me an email. Thanks again!

Noted, Winson. The question is with JD and the answer reaches you here or by email at the address on your order.

Take care, and we will speak soon.
